question: Which region had the lowest total order amount?
sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY total_amount ASC LIMIT 1

question: Lowest selling region
sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY total_amount ASC LIMIT 1
